name: MSX turbo R
description: The final MSX standard, introduced in 1990 and built only by Panasonic as the FS-A1ST and FS-A1GT. It added the 16-bit-capable R800 processor alongside a Z80 for compatibility, plus PCM audio. It marked the end of the MSX line.

specs.cpu: ASCII R800 @ 7.16 MHz + Zilog Z80 @ 3.58 MHz

curiosities: Only Panasonic ever made turbo R machines, and only two models were released.
The R800 processor runs Z80 code and adds a hardware multiplier.
The FS-A1GT added a built-in MIDI interface.
It also contains a Z80 and switches to it for older software that needs exact Z80 timing.
